interface.signature: def validateBinaryTreeNodes(n: int, leftChild: List[int], rightChild: List[int]) -> bool:

preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
Both leftChild and rightChild lists have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= lc <= n - 1 for lc in leftChild) and all(-1 <= rc <= n - 1 for rc in rightChild)
preconditions.description: All child references are either -1 (no child) or valid node indices between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (len([i for i in range(n) if in_degree[i] == 0]) == 1 and all(in_degree[i] <= 1 for i in range(n)) and reachable_count == n)
postconditions.description: Returns true if and only if there is exactly one root (in-degree 0), no node has more than one parent (in-degree <= 1), and all n nodes are reachable from the root.
